evidence: GaAs growth was performed in a horizontal reactor system ... using trimethylgallium /H20849TMGa/H20850and arsine /H20849AsH3/H20850as precursors. Alternating gas pulses of TMGa /H208493s /H20850and AsH3 /H208498s /H20850at flow rates of 5.3/H1100310−5 and 4.5 /H1100310−3 mol min−1, respectively, were separated by a hydrogen purge /H208492s /H20850to prevent the reactant gases from mixing in the gas phase.
